normalization_decisions_for_modeler: Preserve reported financials. Forecast normalization is a separately identified analyst assumption.
Use a separately selected recurring tax rate, with FY2023/FY2024 reported ETRs and the FY2025 tax-release reconciliation visible.
Do not grow all other current assets as operating working capital: held-for-sale assets and tax receivables are identified separately.
Keep cloud amortization distinct from reported cash-flow D&A; cloud implementation spending sits in operating cash flows and other assets, not necessarily PPE capex.
Do not subtract R&D, advertising already included in an aggregate opex measure, or stock compensation twice.
For a rent-expensed valuation, do not also deduct operating lease liabilities as debt without corresponding cash-flow adjustments. Finance lease ROU is prepaid and has no outstanding lease liability.

Beginning/ending cash reconciles with reported FX effects; historical cash changes are not simply changes in USD balance-sheet operating accounts because FX, acquisitions and reclassifications also occur.
FY2024 treasury purchases in equity are 8129 while cash payments are 8094. Preserve the 35 difference instead of forcing equality.
A period-end basic share count is not the diluted weighted-average denominator used for reported EPS. Prospective dilution needs a separately specified share schedule.
Freezing unsupported nonoperating balances is a forecast convention, not a prediction or a fact from the filings.

Not issuer adjusted EBIT or recurring normalized profit.

The Glad terminal payment is included as a claim; reported earnings contain related royalty costs. No unreported acquisition pro-forma benefit is assumed.

target_claim_review.noncontrolling_or_preferred_claims: No separate preferred-stock or noncontrolling-interest balance is presented in the consolidated balance sheet; absence of a presented balance is not a legal capitalization opinion.
target_claim_review.modeling_decision: For a rent-expensed convention exclude operating leases from financing debt. If the tax claim is never settled in forecast cash flows, either deduct an explicitly rounded1100 tax-claim proxy in the equity bridge or disclose the omission and sensitivity. Do not deduct the same claim again if its settlement is already in forecast cash flows.
target_claim_review.coverage_limit: This record is not a complete closing claims register. Accrued liabilities, uncertain taxes, contingent liabilities, cash accessibility, dilution, and events between Aug31 reported balances and Oct31 hypothetical model start require closing-date review.
